title: Sicilian Defense: Moscow Variation
line: White checks with a bishop to trade it off; Black blocks with its own bishop and builds a center.

steps.text: Here White's bishop gives check, to trade itself off and stay out of the main lines.
Block the check with your bishop.

also.b8d7: That also blocks the check. This lesson goes on with the bishop.
also.b8c6: That also blocks the check. This lesson goes on with the bishop.

steps.text: Take back with the queen. Your knight can still come out to c6.

also.b8d7: That takes back too. This lesson takes with the queen.

steps.text: Push the pawn on e7 one square, so your bishop can come out.
Push the pawn on d6 one square. Now you have a share of the center.
Jump to e4 with the knight. Your pawn on d5 guards it.
steps.after: The knight sits in the center, guarded by your pawn, and Black has a share of the center.

summary: Black blocks the check, trades the bishops, and builds a share of the center with pawns and a knight.
